{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an HDMI cable and do not currently need a longer one.
ItemID: 2; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage interests me, but I have no current need for a 4TB internal drive.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on computer accessories, and I am not looking for a voice assistant.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in maintaining my computer and Raspberry Pi setup than adding a streaming device.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a current use for a dedicated smart display.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display does not address my current accessory and connectivity needs.
ItemID: 7; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Short Ethernet cables could help tidy nearby connections, which fits my recent networking and cable-management purchases.
ItemID: 8; Title: SABRENT USB 3.0 to SATA External Hard Drive Lay Flat Docking Station with Built in Cooling Fan for 2.5 or 3.5in HDD, SSD [Support UASP and 22TB] (EC-DFFN); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in computer accessories, but I would wait until I have a spare SATA drive to use with it.
ItemID: 9; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A powered hub could organize my keyboard, adapters, and other USB accessories, and individual switches sound useful.
ItemID: 10; Title: Amazon Ethernet Adapter for Amazon Fire TV Devices; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have not shown a need for Fire TV accessories, and I already have a USB Ethernet adapter for my computer."}
